svg.text: FEAR PASS · THE CREATURE · ROUND 2
The Ophan in the castle
larger than the room it is in
lapis: the owner's call
two of you, 1.80 m
KEEP CELL · 12 m · TWO STOREYS OF 4.6 m · 1 m = 50 px
Stone pulled back to the quarry
where it passes; it closes after
Through floor, walls and roof
it is larger than the house
THE GREAT RIM, CLOSE
rim 0.25 m deep · eyes 0.20 m · the four Ages' years in portal light
WHEN IT COMES
As the portal's clock runs low the floors begin to tick.
Then the light, then the wheels, through whatever is in
the way.
WHY YOU CANNOT FIGHT IT
It is larger than the castle and not wholly in one
moment. A blow lands on where it was.
ITS COUNTER, PROPOSED
None. Carry what it asked for, or reach the portal before
it reaches you.
